environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: Alternating baseline/current pairs, fresh Node per candidate. Same 24 pinned Kodak images. Seven pairs for responsive/lqip-build/preview/client; three default automatic-import pairs. Persistent tool cache deleted before each cold build; warm keeps cache, OS cache unflushed. All emitted image digest/byte multisets or complete preview JSON digests must match. Preview reads sources before timer, one first 24-photo batch, one warmup batch, three timed batches (72 previews). Client mounts real Svelte Image/Picture, includes Svelte runtime; gzip9. Isolated entry output budgets measured separately. No simultaneous heavy checks; uncontrolled desktop. processWallMs also includes process setup and validation.
